item.text: The first screenshots exposed overly strong sand ripples and vegetation that looks like separate dark balls. I’ll soften and vary the ripples, blend the canopy into the ridges, and break up the uniform surf lines. The headland now frames the cove, and the turquoise gradient is still readable.

item.text: Round two has subtler sand texture and clearer surf. It also revealed excessive sun glare and a material tint that was making the foliage nearly black. I’ve corrected those and replaced the stretched cloud patches with rounded cumulus shapes for the third review.

Completed three screenshot→fix rounds and regenerated all A views.

- Added dunes, berm, wet sand, tide debris, surf, blue sky, cumulus, rocky island and vegetated headland.
- Preserved slots, loader, cameras and scripts.
- Updated [NOTES.md](/home/cw/git_project/beach3d-eval/NOTES.md).
- Build, screenshots and verification pass.
